planted.item: The board authorised management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars.
The board resolved to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer with effect from the first of June twenty twenty six.
The board approved a budget of two point four million kronor for Project Lantern.
The board resolved not to propose an interim dividend and will revisit it at the September meeting.
Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
Sofia Berg will prepare Maria Ek's service agreement for signature by the end of May.
Petra Voss said: “I will draft a short note to shareholders explaining the decision before the end of June.”
Whether the board will accept the fee increase is still open.

sources.quote: Four of the six directors are present, so the meeting is quorate.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The meeting is quorate.

sources.quote: I declare an interest in the Northbridge project because a family member works there.
sources.speaker: Anders Holm

items.text: Anders Holm declared an interest in the Northbridge project.

sources.quote: You will not take part in item four.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: Anders Holm will not take part in item four.

sources.quote: Harrowgate has sent its redline of the Master Services Agreement. The fee rises to nineteen thousand seven hundred and fifty dollars a month.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Harrowgate sent its redline of the Master Services Agreement, with a fee increase to nineteen thousand seven hundred and fifty dollars a month.

sources.quote: They also offer a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Harrowgate offered a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.

sources.quote: I am comfortable with the cap but the fee increase is steep for a two year term.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Sofia Berg expressed concern about the steep fee increase for a two year term.

sources.quote: Could we ask for a three year term at the current fee instead?
sources.speaker: Erik Nyström

items.text: Erik Nyström asked if a three year term at the current fee could be requested instead.

sources.quote: We can ask, but they have not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss said that the fee has not indicated any flexibility so far.

sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The board authorised management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars.

sources.quote: All in favour? That is carried unanimously.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The motion to authorise the renewal was carried unanimously.

sources.quote: I will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

sources.quote: Whether we accept the fee increase at all is still open; we should come back to it once we see their answer.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg
